summary: perf(l10n): move localizeTimestamp out of the shared l10n barrel
description:
Because:
- Settings imports from the @fxa/shared/l10n barrel, which pulled in moment.
- l10n.utils.ts imported moment at the top level only for localizeTimestamp.

This commit:
- Moves localizeTimestamp to l10n.timestamp.ts with entry @fxa/shared/l10n/timestamp.
- Adds the alias to tsconfig.base.json and the admin-server tsconfig.build.json.
- Adds a jest moduleNameMapper entry in the auth-server.
- Updates connected-services formatters.ts and auth-server lib/customs.js.
- Moves the tests unchanged to l10n.timestamp.spec.ts.

Closes FXA-9218
